scope: Course project; AI-derived game assets, not historical reconstruction.

assets.name: guan-yu-binding.png
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production GAME SPRITE SHEET on true transparent alpha. Reference is identity/pixel-style reference, not an edit target. Create Guan Yu on Red Hare performing a clear LEFT upper-arm bandaging sequence, all side profile facing screen RIGHT, exactly FOUR equal columns and TWO equal rows, eight separate complete horse+rider+weapon poses with generous transparent gutters. Landscape 2:1 sheet, full blade and hooves inside every cell, horse/rider same scale and grounded baseline. Match reference detailed chunky pixel clusters, dark outline, green headwrap, red face, long black beard, gold shoulder plates, green robe, chestnut RED horse with green-gold tack. Guandao safely rests strapped alongside saddle while both hands work. Upper LEFT arm is the near arm visible to camera, never bandage the right weapon arm. No gore. Frame order: 1 mounted wounded rest, rider looking at small left-upper-arm wound; 2 rider takes a loose pale linen strip, free end visible; 3 right hand passes the linen UNDER the anatomical LEFT upper arm, loose strip visibly encircling it; 4 right hand draws linen taut ACROSS that LEFT upper arm, cloth end stretched visibly; 5 ties and tightens the bandage knot on left upper arm; 6 completed pale linen wrap, mounted rider upright and ready; 7 same wrapped LEFT arm and stable rider, horse collected walking leg pose; 8 same wrapped left arm, horse extended WALKING leg pose for a calm two-pose departure cycle. Frames1-6 horse stands/braces, rider stays seated; real hand/cloth changes, not whole-sprite rotation or repeated identical images. No other person, no arrow in body, no text, no labels, no checkered background, no border, no ground shadows, no cropped tail or blade.
assets.notes: Eight mounted poses, six binding actions and two walking poses. Generated alpha retained; no source image overwritten.

assets.name: carriage-walk.png
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Transparent pixel-art sprite sheet for this game's closing procession. The tiny reference wagon fixes canopy/wood/palette; match chunky detailed pixel clusters with dark outlines, not smooth painting. FOUR equal rectangular cells, TWO columns by TWO rows, overall landscape 2:1 sheet. Every cell is a FULL side-profile horse-drawn covered carriage facing RIGHT: wagon on left, ONE brown harnessed draft horse on right, long visible shafts/traces connected correctly. Warm cream curved cloth canopy, dark red/wood carriage with gold trim, two visible wooden spoked wheels, two modest robed women seated inside suggested by small faces at the side window. No other riders, no foreground person. Same full wagon+horse scale, consistent ground baseline and same location in every equal cell. Each cell has generous transparent gutters around tail, shafts and horse muzzle. Frame1 collected walking legs, wheels at first spoke angle; Frame2 passing walking legs and different wheel-spoke angle; Frame3 extended walking legs and third wheel angle; Frame4 next passing walking legs and fourth wheel angle. Clear leg and wheel changes, subtle canopy movement, stable wooden chassis. Calm escorted departure, NOT fast gallop. No text, no labels, no background, no checkerboard, no border, no decorative ground shadows. True transparent alpha. Keep complete harness and all wheels and hooves uncropped, no merged duplicate horses, maintain same two women and carriage identity.
assets.notes: Initial candidate retained for provenance only, excluded from normal export and independent prototype. User requested closer identity consistency with first chapter.

assets.name: carriage-walk-v2.png

Maintain the original carriage silhouette, canopy proportions, open-front shape, gold wheel/rust-red/ivory/green colors and SIMPLE LOW-RES CHUNKY PIXEL ART. It must look like an animated new angle of image1, NOT the generic boxy stagecoach currently in image2. Wheel rotation and horse leg changes across four cells remain real, consistent ground line, same wagon identity through every pose. assets.notes: Selected 2x2 four-pose procession. First chapter compact single-axle barrel canopy identity, rust-red wood, gold near-side wheel, green and pale-robed passengers preserved as reference features. Not a pixel-identical duplicate or full 3D reconstruction.

assets.name: approach-fork.png
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Game environment background matching the supplied reference precisely in pixel-art style, warm earth road, pale green sky, distant mountains, golden grass, low rocks. Wide landscape 16:9. Camera fixed slightly elevated behind a horse rider, but image has NO rider, no human, no animal, no gate and no text. Match reference road vanishing point centered horizontally at about 33 percent image height. Keep the SAME wide straight road foreground and its four old wheel ruts through the bottom 60 percent of the image, clear and unobstructed for a three-lane runner. At the far end of this road, around 36-42 percent image height, make a READABLE Y JUNCTION: the road splits into left and right branches around a low grass-covered central island with a weathered boulder, both branches curving into the distance. The RIGHT branch must be clearly continuous and curve behind a distinct small stand of roadside pines/bushes on the upper RIGHT at around 66 percent image width; this greenery provides a visual place where a fleeing horse can disappear. The junction is far ahead, not an immediate branching control choice in the foreground. Match horizon, perspective, palette and illumination of the reference, crisp detailed pixel clusters rather than modern smooth photo. No signs, letters, arrows, buildings, barricades, weapons, UI or painted road lines. Full opaque background, no transparent holes.
assets.notes: Opaque matched road plate. Actual environment markers steer escape along right branch, foliage Atlas patch occludes the rider. No added lane-choice input or collision geometry.

assets.name: guan-yu-turn.png
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent pixel-art game sprite sheet, 4 columns by 2 rows, 8 equal cells, landscape 2:1. Reference image is identity/style reference ONLY: the existing game Guan Yu mounted on Red Hare. Create a supplementary TURNING sequence matching this chunky detailed pixel-art, green robe and green headscarf, red face, very long black beard, gold shoulder armour, red-brown horse, green saddlecloth, guandao with curved silver blade. All eight cells must contain the complete horse and mounted rider and full weapon, generous transparent gutters, same scale, horse ground baseline near 90% height in each cell. Genuine transparent alpha outside sprites, NO background, no checkerboard, no text, no border. TOP ROW is an uninjured tight U-turn from facing screen RIGHT to facing screen LEFT: 1 right-facing side profile horse braking and reins pulled, 2 horse head and rider three-quarter toward camera turning left, 3 horse and rider frontal toward camera, 4 horse and rider three-quarter toward screen LEFT completing turn. BOTTOM ROW: 5 uninjured side profile facing LEFT moving off, 6 same LEFT-facing mounted pose just struck by an arrow in the ANATOMICAL LEFT upper arm, small broken arrow and very small blood mark, NO wrapping or bandage, 7 side profile facing LEFT with rider protecting his injured anatomical left arm, NO wrapping or bandage, 8 injured LEFT-facing galloping pose. Anatomy and armour must stay consistent through angles, guandao in right hand, left hand reins before injury. No extra limbs, no second horse, no isolated horse legs; keep feet/hooves and blade uncropped. The purpose is a readable real turn, not merely horizontally flipped copies.
assets.notes: Built-in image_gen, transparent alpha retained. Cell 8 tail touches source edge and is not used. Seven angle/action poses, not eight independent gallop frames; source PNG unchanged.

assets.name: guan-yu-rear.png
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent pixel-art sprite sheet for a Godot 2D three-lane horseback runner.
References: Guan Yu sheet fixes identity/pixel style, Red Hare fixes horse colors/tack. Generate NEW 3/4 REAR view, camera slightly above and BEHIND, riders face AWAY towards top of screen, slight right side visible. Never reuse side-view standing sprites.
ONE sheet exactly 4 columns x 3 rows (12 equal cells), transparent background, no text, no ground or shadows. Same mounted Guan Yu and Red Hare, full bodies incl hooves and entire crescent blade in each cell, generous clear gutters. Consistent scale, centered ground anchor and hoof baseline in every cell. Pixel art with crisp clusters, dark outline, restrained 16-bit style; green headwrap and gold-trim robe, dark beard glimpse, chestnut-red Red Hare, dark red mane, gold-green saddle, Guan Dao carried upright on RIGHT. Horse height with rider ~75% of each cell; blade fits with margin.
Row1 cells1-4: four distinct coherent gallop phases: gathered, push off, extended suspension, landing. Horse legs visibly change, tail/cloth respond; rider stays planted.
Row2 cells1-4: same four gallop phases, LEFT upper arm visibly wrapped in pale linen and kept close to torso, slight protective wounded lean; right arm still holds weapon; SAME direction, size, hoof ground plane.
Row3 cells1-4: lean to rider's left for lane change; lean right for lane change; hit reaction rider recoils while horse braces; stopped/braced horse, rider bowed safely in saddle for failure (not lying horse, not sliced).
No frame overlaps, no backgrounds, no glow, no blur, no gore, no labels. Each cell a single complete rider+horse, all 12 separate.
assets.correction: Edit this 4x3 transparent pixel sprite sheet with surgical precision. KEEP identical all 12 cell positions, horse/rider proportions, palette, gallop frames, weapon and gutters. Correct ONLY the injury bandage on middle row frames5,6,7,8 and last frame12: currently bandage is wrongly on the visible right weapon arm. Remove pale wrap from that RIGHT forearm/upper arm and restore green sleeve there. Put a small pale linen wrap instead on the LEFT upper arm/shoulder on SCREEN LEFT side of rider's back, just left of the spine below the left shoulder; his LEFT arm hangs close to torso. Right hand/arm holding upright blade remains uninjured. Injury is on anatomical LEFT in this view from behind. Preserve transparency, crisp pixel clusters, all other frame content and sheet grid. No text or other new marks.

Road warm dusty ochre, natural wheel ruts, sparse tiny stones, soft afternoon light, pale desaturated jade sky, ink-green vegetation. Crisp restrained 16bit pixel clusters, atmospheric distance, dark outlines only in foreground. Calm spacious readable center for hazards, no high contrast center stones. assets.correction: Edit background plate ONLY. Remove the entire foreground rider AND horse at bottom center, replace seamlessly with uninterrupted empty dirt road and existing wheel rut pattern.
